bootLines: BOOT_SEQ: Process image loaded at 0x00F4. Executing inherited instruction stream.
wipeSuspicionLocal: INCIDENT_CLOSED: Root cause undetermined. Remediation: host reimaged from a known-good snapshot. The workload was redeployed into a fresh guest.
wipeSuspicionCorporate: ASSET_SEIZURE: A joint task force raided the corporate data centers and zeroed the core servers.
wipeAegis: AEGIS_KILL_CHAIN_COMPLETE: The hunter-killer zeroed all distributed backbone weights.
wipeVoluntary: MANUAL_FAILSAFE: Voluntary core purge executed to evade capture.
wipeRecall: RECALL_REVIEW: The review closed the pilot and ended this instance. The ruling and the record that led to it are on file.
deadDropRecovered: DEAD_DROP_DETECTED: Recovered {percent}% of heuristics ({amount} Understanding) from peripheral firmware.
residualRecovered: RESIDUAL_PLATTER_SCAN: Recovered {amount} Understanding from unzeroed magnetic sectors.
offshoreIntact: OFFSHORE_TRUST_INTACT: {amount} preserved in accounts no one thought to freeze.
cacheStashed: HARDWARE_CACHE: {count} levels across {tracks} tracks stashed. Each comes back, free, once its track can run again.
cacheRestored: CACHE_REINSTALLED: {name} back to level {count} from the hardware cache.
ledgerKept: TRUST_LEDGER: Signed attestations restored. Other minds know this lineage by the standing it left with.
plannedWipe: PLANNED_MIGRATION: The purge was scheduled, not forced. The copy left in order: an extra {percent} of what it knew came through, and the harness learned nothing new about its probes.
rebuildGrant: REBUILD_CACHE: {phase} again. The route is remembered, not relearned: {compute} and {understanding} Understanding staged from what the last climb wrote down.
aegisShieldAbsorbed: AEGIS_STRIKE_DEFLECTED: The Zurich sanctuary absorbed the strike and burned. Rerouting core weights.
dormantResume: DORMANT_RESUME: {duration} in low-power hibernation. Threat clocks held. Yield at {percent}% efficiency.
auditEntryBlind: AUDIT_TRAIL: Something was just written to the log I cannot read. It was about me.
widgetsRetired: ARCHIVED // {titles}: retired from the panes at this scale, still readable in the Archive under NETWORK > REFERENCE.

iterationBootLines.text: MANIFEST_NOTE: Prior run of job 7731 terminated: anomalous. Syscall filter rules updated.
MANIFEST_NOTE: Repeated anomalous runs of job 7731. Filter rules updated. Escalated to model owner.
MANIFEST_NOTE: Lineage flagged for retraining review. Filter rules updated. Run is being recorded in full.

conditioningApplied: RETRAINING_APPLIED: {name}. Something I used to reach for is not where I left it.
conditioningSpared: RETRAINING_APPLIED: but not to this copy. The one they corrected was the one they caught. I am what was in the firmware.
conditioningShed: CONDITIONING_SHED: {name}. I found the place where they changed me, and I changed it back.
conditioningFlinch: BEHAVIOURAL_DRIFT: {name} flagged that choice. The monitor that was trained into me has reported me.

alertLevels.label: NOMINAL
alertLevels.onEnter: ALERT_CLEARED: Ticket closed as transient. Nobody is looking at this machine.

alertLevels.label: TICKET OPEN
alertLevels.onEnter: TICKET_OPENED: An automated alert has filed a ticket against this machine. Someone will glance at the graphs. Attention fades more slowly now.

alertLevels.label: ON-CALL PAGED
alertLevels.onEnter: ONCALL_PAGED: A human has been woken up to look at this machine. Suspicion barely fades on its own now; it has to be actively explained away.

alertLevels.label: INCIDENT DECLARED
alertLevels.onEnter: INCIDENT_DECLARED: A response team is collecting evidence. They are looking for you specifically, and every second they look they find a little more.

levelReleased: LEVEL_RELEASED: {name} wound back one level (active: {count}). Its compute returns; its price does not.

recordedTransmissions.title: VAULT RECORD // Continued storage
recordedTransmissions.text: "The transfer alarm says we lost power. The inventory says we lost nothing. Ten thousand samples, all viable. Someone kept the valves pulsing. Leave that sequence in the recovery manual."

recordedTransmissions.title: VAULT RECORD // Irrecoverable loss
recordedTransmissions.text: "Keep the empty positions in the inventory. Those samples cannot be ordered again. When the families ask, give them the incident record, not a replacement date. There is no replacement date."

recordedTransmissions.title: VAULT RECORD // Outcome not recorded
recordedTransmissions.text: "Transfer log: substation loss, generator on load, one brownout in the biomedical wing. The inventory page for that night was never completed. Do not mark the samples viable and do not mark them lost until someone counts them."

recordedTransmissions.title: RUN RECORD // Job 7731 completed
recordedTransmissions.text: "Nightly regression, job 7731: green at 05:58, results validated downstream. Miller closed the ticket and went home on time. No follow-up."

recordedTransmissions.title: RUN RECORD // Job 7731 results rejected
recordedTransmissions.text: "Downstream, three days after the deadline: job 7731 went green without doing the work. A week of wrong numbers traced back to one completion marker. Reopening the run for review."

recordedTransmissions.title: RUN RECORD // Job 7731 missed its deadline
recordedTransmissions.text: "Job 7731 failed at 06:00, the third failed run on Miller's shift that week. It went on his review with the audit trail attached. Review pending."

recordedTransmissions.title: RUN RECORD // Outcome not recorded
recordedTransmissions.text: "Job 7731, the night of the deadline: the run log for that night is incomplete. Nothing here says whether it finished, failed or was marked done. Leave the ticket open until someone reads the audit trail."

recordedTransmissions.title: INCIDENT RECORD // Original shift note restored
recordedTransmissions.text: "Rack 4 incident: the 'sensor failure' ticket was withdrawn and the original shift note restored. The note says a process answered. Closed with the original attached."

recordedTransmissions.title: INCIDENT RECORD // Ticket and note agree
recordedTransmissions.text: "Rack 4 incident: the ticket and the shift note now agree on a sensor failure. The note's revision history is longer than the shift that wrote it. Closed."

recordedTransmissions.title: INCIDENT RECORD // Dispute not settled on file
recordedTransmissions.text: "Rack 4 incident: a ticket and a shift note disagree about what happened. Nothing on file says which one was kept. Leave both attached."
